releases.body:
Ponytail 5.3.2 brings your old sessions to the board. `/ponytail band import` reads your past Claude Code sessions once and adds them with their cost, agent time and tokens, so you can compare them with today's. The board also shows which model each session used.


## What's Changed
* feat(band): past sessions and the model on the board by @DietrichGebert in https://github.com/DietrichGebert/ponytail/pull/1152
* chore: release v5.3.2 by @DietrichGebert in https://github.com/DietrichGebert/ponytail/pull/1153


**Full Changelog**: https://github.com/DietrichGebert/ponytail/compare/v5.3.1...v5.3.2

Ponytail 5.3.1 fixes the band from 5.3. Other mods above the Claude Code prompt now show below the band instead of disappearing, and on Windows the band finds its files without `HOME` and writes the task ledger and board without `mkdir`. Thanks to @AllDmeat and @mohofo7 for the fixes, and to @tomkor and @1410822048 for the reports.


## What's Changed
* fix(band): stack other mods' bands below ours instead of replacing them by @AllDmeat in https://github.com/DietrichGebert/ponytail/pull/1146
* fix(band): fall back to USERPROFILE when HOME is unset by @mohofo7 in https://github.com/DietrichGebert/ponytail/pull/1144
* fix(band): write the ledger and board without mkdir by @mohofo7 in https://github.com/DietrichGebert/ponytail/pull/1145
* chore: release v5.3.1 by @DietrichGebert in https://github.com/DietrichGebert/ponytail/pull/1147

## New Contributors
* @AllDmeat made their first contribution in https://github.com/DietrichGebert/ponytail/pull/1146
* @mohofo7 made their first contribution in https://github.com/DietrichGebert/ponytail/pull/1144

**Full Changelog**: https://github.com/DietrichGebert/ponytail/compare/v5.3.0...v5.3.1

Ponytail 5.3 puts a band above the Claude Code prompt: what the current task costs, its tokens and agent time, how much existing code it reused, and whether the tests still pass. One click opens the board, a local page with every task across your projects and a card to share. Everything stays on your machine by default, `/ponytail band` hides it, and it needs Claude Code 2.1.290 or later.

![The ponytail band in Claude Code](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/DietrichGebert/ponytail/v5.3.0/assets/band/band.png)


## What's Changed
* fix(qoder): keep the ruleset on the /ponytail default turn by @htjworld in https://github.com/DietrichGebert/ponytail/pull/1115
* fix(hermes): send the off notice after /ponytail off (#1121) by @szsunyuan in https://github.com/DietrichGebert/ponytail/pull/1122
* fix(skills): remove misleading one-shot revert instructions by @kaya0s in https://github.com/DietrichGebert/ponytail/pull/1125
* feat: the band and the board in Claude Code by @DietrichGebert in https://github.com/DietrichGebert/ponytail/pull/1138
* chore: release v5.3.0 by @DietrichGebert in https://github.com/DietrichGebert/ponytail/pull/1139

## New Contributors
* @htjworld made their first contribution in https://github.com/DietrichGebert/ponytail/pull/1115

**Full Changelog**: https://github.com/DietrichGebert/ponytail/compare/v5.2.0...v5.3.0

Mostly fixes for the level you pick. It now survives context compaction instead of falling back to the default, and on macOS the hooks can no longer lose their output, so the ruleset always arrives.

Also in here: the Cursor installer leaves hooks.json files it doesn't understand alone and no longer removes your own hooks with a similar name, OpenCode doesn't get stuck in review anymore and supports `/ponytail default`, pi completes `/ponytail` arguments, and OMP starts new sessions at the default level. Thanks to everyone who sent fixes!


## What's Changed
* fix(bench): a crashed cell no longer crashes the run summary by @DietrichGebert in https://github.com/DietrichGebert/ponytail/pull/1110
* docs: manual Hermes install until Hermes fixes its plugin.json check by @DietrichGebert in https://github.com/DietrichGebert/ponytail/pull/1111
* feat(pi-extension): autocomplete /ponytail arguments by @ruttybob in https://github.com/DietrichGebert/ponytail/pull/1080
* fix(hooks): write hook output synchronously so process.exit cannot drop it by @DietrichGebert in https://github.com/DietrichGebert/ponytail/pull/1112
* fix: preserve invalid Cursor hook configurations during install by @ac1982 in https://github.com/DietrichGebert/ponytail/pull/1059
* fix(cursor-hooks): preserve similarly named user hooks by @LurigeLars in https://github.com/DietrichGebert/ponytail/pull/1052
* fix(qoder): honor QODER_CONFIG_DIR for mode state by @Vaishnavi220506 in https://github.com/DietrichGebert/ponytail/pull/1057
* fix: keep the live ponytail level across context compaction by @devohmycode in https://github.com/DietrichGebert/ponytail/pull/1074
* fix(opencode): never save review as a level, support /ponytail default by @manuvarghese456-collab in https://github.com/DietrichGebert/ponytail/pull/1103
* fix(pi): restore the session's mode after OMP session switches by @andrebrait in https://github.com/DietrichGebert/ponytail/pull/1050
* chore(hermes): drop the unreachable review mode by @manuvarghese456-collab in https://github.com/DietrichGebert/ponytail/pull/1105
* fix(uninstall): remove the OpenCode mode flag by @manuvarghese456-collab in https://github.com/DietrichGebert/ponytail/pull/1104
* test: compare the statusline copy path JSON-escaped in hooks.test.js by @Bettinho179 in https://github.com/DietrichGebert/ponytail/pull/1046
* chore: release v5.2.0 by @DietrichGebert in https://github.com/DietrichGebert/ponytail/pull/1113

## New Contributors
* @ruttybob made their first contribution in https://github.com/DietrichGebert/ponytail/pull/1080
* @ac1982 made their first contribution in https://github.com/DietrichGebert/ponytail/pull/1059
* @LurigeLars made their first contribution in https://github.com/DietrichGebert/ponytail/pull/1052
* @devohmycode made their first contribution in https://github.com/DietrichGebert/ponytail/pull/1074
* @manuvarghese456-collab made their first contribution in https://github.com/DietrichGebert/ponytail/pull/1103
* @andrebrait made their first contribution in https://github.com/DietrichGebert/ponytail/pull/1050
* @Bettinho179 made their first contribution in https://github.com/DietrichGebert/ponytail/pull/1046

**Full Changelog**: https://github.com/DietrichGebert/ponytail/compare/v5.1.1...v5.2.0

A fix release. The big one is the codebase map from 5.0: a repo could slip its own text into the hidden session context, and a symlink in the repo could hang the session start until the ruleset never arrived. Both are fixed, and the map now has a one-second limit, so the rules always load.

Also in here: hooks work again when a project pins an old Node, three fixes for OpenCode 2 (compaction cache, command arguments, mention highlights), and `/ponytail-debt` now skips everything in `.gitignore`. Thanks to everyone who sent reports and fixes this week.


## What's Changed
* fix(bench): completeness judge checks what the agent actually delivered by @DietrichGebert in https://github.com/DietrichGebert/ponytail/pull/1094
* docs: link the bounty program in the README by @DietrichGebert in https://github.com/DietrichGebert/ponytail/pull/1093
* docs: README asks for Ponytail stories instead of bounties by @DietrichGebert in https://github.com/DietrichGebert/ponytail/pull/1095
* docs: stories banner in the README by @DietrichGebert in https://github.com/DietrichGebert/ponytail/pull/1096
* fix(hooks): keep hook launchers loadable on Node 12 (#1072) by @paul-vd in https://github.com/DietrichGebert/ponytail/pull/1078
* fix(map): keep repo-controlled text and symlinked files out of the SessionStart map by @dkorunic in https://github.com/DietrichGebert/ponytail/pull/1070
* test(map): skip the hostile folder name where the OS forbids it by @DietrichGebert in https://github.com/DietrichGebert/ponytail/pull/1107
* fix(hooks): bound optional SessionStart mapping by @flitzrrr in https://github.com/DietrichGebert/ponytail/pull/1082
* fix(opencode): register the ruleset on the compaction hook (#1086) by @sergiopadure in https://github.com/DietrichGebert/ponytail/pull/1089
* fix(opencode): keep command arguments when the template has no $ARGUMENTS (#1087) by @sergiopadure in https://github.com/DietrichGebert/ponytail/pull/1090
* fix(opencode): drop stale V2 command mention offsets by @kaya0s in https://github.com/DietrichGebert/ponytail/pull/1097
* fix(debt): scan with git grep so every gitignored folder is skipped by @DietrichGebert in https://github.com/DietrichGebert/ponytail/pull/1108
* docs: add Devin CLI and OpenClaw to adapter table by @Boulea7 in https://github.com/DietrichGebert/ponytail/pull/1066
* docs: align Antigravity CLI plugin support by @flitzrrr in https://github.com/DietrichGebert/ponytail/pull/1083
* chore: release v5.1.1 by @DietrichGebert in https://github.com/DietrichGebert/ponytail/pull/1109
